_comment: Eight recurring FICTIONAL NPCs. Schedules: first matching entry wins; days are weekdays 0=Mon..6=Sun or "all". Real/partner figures live in data/partner/ only.

stranger: Bunk's yours. Rent's due weekly. I don't do sob stories, but I do do payment plans.
known: You're still here! That's more than most comics manage.
Somebody left a joke book in the kitchen. Not yours, right? Good.
close: I told my sister about you. She asked when you're on TV. No pressure.

stranger: You new? I'm Deshawn. Four months in. Still bombing, but faster now.
known: You want to workshop something? I'll trade you a tag for a tag.
I've put my name in that bucket nineteen times. Twentieth is the charm.
close: When you make it, you better put me on your shows. I'm serious. Half serious.

stranger: Need work? I always need a server. Nobody stays. Comedians especially.
known: You show up on time. You'd be amazed how rare that is.
If you're doing comedy, do a bit about my eggs. They're famous.
close: Take Thursday off if you need it. I've got you covered.

stranger: Door staff only back here. Unless you want a job. Then talk.
known: Reliable door people are rarer than funny comics.
Keep showing up and I'll find you a late spot.
close: Late show's yours if you want it. Don't make me regret it.

stranger: Writing? Corner table has the outlet. Don't tell the screenplay guys.
known: I read your notebook upside down. Your second joke's better than your first.
Free refill if you tell me a premise.
close: I submitted a script to a festival. Your notes helped. Seriously.

npcs.name: Wade 'Dusty' Ames
npcs.role: Open-mic host at the Rusty Spur

stranger: List goes up at seven. Five bucks at the bar gets you on it. Three minutes. When the light goes on, you wrap it up.
known: Your timing's getting better. Your jokes are... also there.
Respect the light. I mean it.
close: I'm putting you up early tonight. Real crowd, not just comics.

stranger: I book this room. I watch the open mics. I'll find you if you're ready.
known: I've heard good things. Keep getting up.
Don't overrun my showcase. I will remember.
close: I've got a feature spot coming up. You're on my short list.

stranger: Headliner. Twenty years on the road. Don't ask me for advice unless you want a lot of it.
known: Write every day. Even the bad days. Especially the bad days.
The minute is the hardest thing in comedy. Short setups.
close: I need an opener for a weekend run eventually. Stay sharp.
